achievements.label: Dead On
achievements.description: Make landfall with the ship ending within half a nautical mile of where your own plot said she would.

achievements.label: Trust the Numbers
achievements.description: Earn three stars on a chart without using any steer-to helper or the par plan.

achievements.label: Around the Rocks
achievements.description: Make landfall on a chart with three hazards on the direct line.

achievements.label: Set and Drift
achievements.description: Make landfall on a chart with a current, beating the naive plan by at least half.

achievements.label: First Fix
achievements.description: Take a landmark fix in Watch-by-watch.

achievements.label: Fog of War-ish
achievements.description: Make landfall on a fog chart.

achievements.label: Riding the Tide
achievements.description: Make landfall with the tidal stream fair for most of the time you spent in it.

achievements.label: Patient Navigator
achievements.description: Lie at anchor to wait for the tide, then make landfall.

achievements.label: Two at Once
achievements.description: Make landfall with both ships on a two-ship chart.

achievements.label: Long Way Round
achievements.description: Make landfall on a plan of more than 60 nautical miles through the water.

achievements.label: Chapter Closer
achievements.description: Make landfall on every chart in a chapter.

achievements.label: All Stars
achievements.description: Earn three stars on every campaign chart.
